units.source_text: 我按写信日期顺序，开始阅读他写在薄信纸上的小字。

en.t: I began reading the tiny characters he had written on thin stationery, in the order of the dates on the letters.

units.source_text: 文笔之差无法形容，思考也处处停滞，不易读下去。

en.t: The writing was indescribably poor, and his thoughts stalled everywhere, making it hard to keep reading.

units.source_text: 不过，从文章的前后来看，字里行间隐约流露出痛苦的情绪来。

en.t: Still, judging from the surrounding passages, a feeling of pain faintly emerged between the lines.

units.source_text: 读到最后的信时，鹤川的苦痛就鲜明地跃然纸上了。

en.t: By the time I reached the last letter, Tsurukawa's suffering stood out vividly on the page.

units.source_text: 随着一封封读下去，我潸潸泪下。

en.t: As I read on, letter after letter, tears streamed down my face.

units.source_text: 我虽然哭泣，但心中却惊愕于鹤川这种凡庸的苦恼。

en.t: Although I was crying, in my heart I was astonished by this ordinary anguish of Tsurukawa's.
